kevin: quick heads up — demand sim for the next 8w shows hosted traffic pushing EU GPU consumption above our reserved commitments around 2025-06-10. estimate +22% peak. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

maria: can you paste the numbers?

kevin: sure, here's the summary I ran (hosted-only):
```
region | reserved(gpu) | projected_peak | delta
EU     | 160           | 195            | +35 (+21.9%)
USW    | 120           | 110            | -10 (-8.3%)
APAC   | 80            | 85             | +5 (+6.3%)
Total  | 360           | 390            | +30 (+8.3%)
```

ajay: is this hosted-only or does it include Dedicated burst / private?

kevin: hosted-only. Dedicated/private excluded. also flagged a billing anomaly: some EU instances that looked like spot were billed at on-demand rates last week — cost-bot flagged it.

cost-bot: Billing alert: 2025-05-22 EU compute charges vs expected: +14% (unmatched reservation usage). See /billing/2025-05-weekly for details.

sam (finance): if on-demand is eating into reserved utilization, we might have a tagging or reservation-assignment mismatch. who owns the reseller/tag pipeline?

maria: infra-tagging team does. I can run a quick audit query: `select region, sku, reservation_id from billing where invoice_week=20250518` and check for null reservation_id.

kevin: short-term hedges I'm proposing: 
- shift ~10% of low-latency-tolerant endpoints to USW via routing policy (routing_policy=cost_aware, prefer_region=us-west)
- enable reserved sharing across EU AZs (needs security sign-off)
- open negotiation with cloud for provisional credit on the mismatch (~30%)

ajay: can we throttle non-critical batch-embed jobs during the expected peak windows? e.g., move batch window from 03:00-07:00 -> 02:00-06:00 to spread load?

maria: yes, and enabling prefix/KV caching on chat sessions should shave ~12% tokens per request, helps steady-state.

kevin: action items and owners:
1) @maria — run tag audit and share SQL results by EOD (target ts: 1764510600)
2) @ajay — add throttling rule for batch-embed and stage the change (deploy tomorrow)
3) @sam (finance) — open billing dispute ticket and ask for provisional credit
4) infra — prepare reserved-share config PR for EU AZs (security aware)

maria: ack, starting the tag audit now.

ajay: will open PR for throttling and put test plan in staging.

sam (finance): opening billing dispute now, will paste ticket ref here once created.

cost-bot: Created billing-ticket: BT-7893

kevin: thanks. we'll reconvene after the tag audit. if the delta looks worse than +25% we should buy short-term spot/ondemand capacity or increase routing shift.

maria: noted. ping me if you want the SQL run iterated or a diff of last 6 weeks.

(quick note: keeping this thread short so ops can triage the three action items.)
